lyrics: Three in the morning, the ceiling's too close
My shadow is buzzing, a terminal dose
Of blue-tinted darkness and silent alarms
A battle I'm losing with my own two arms.
Heart like a hummingbird trapped in my ribs
My own shallow breathing is telling   me fibs
It whispers "relax," but the   circuits all fry
Beneath a relentless, electrical sky.
Wired nerves and a fractured
soul!
Losing all my self-control!
The screen is on, the light is blue!
This frantic pace is running me through!
Coffee and cortisol, that's all there is
The world is a blur of a terrible fizz
My muscles are twitching, my jaw is a
vise
Living my life on a sheet of thin ice.
Wired nerves and a fractured
soul!
Losing all    my self-control!
The screen is on, the light is blue!
This frantic pace is running   me through!
Breathe in... breathe
out... the static screams...
Living on echoes   and
shattered dreams...
Can't find the off switch! Can't
find the release!
Just want a moment... of
silence and peace!
Wired nerves and a fractured soul!
Losing all my self-control!
The screen is on, the light is blue!
This frantic pace is   running me through!
